en.content:
If 100 mole of H2O2 decompose at 1 bar and 300 K, the work done (kJ) by one mole of O2(g) as it expands against 1 bar pressure is :

2H2O2(l)       2H2O(l) + O2(g)

(R = 8.3 J K 1 mol1)
en.explanation:
For reaction : 2H2O2(1) 2H2O(1) + O2(g)

Given, p = 1 bar, T = 300 K, n = 100 mol, R = 8.3 J K mol1

We know that

w = pV = nRT

= 100 8.3 300

= 249000 J or 249 kJ

en.content:
Aqueous solution of which salt will not contain ions with the electronic
configuration 1s<sup>2</sup>2s<sup>2</sup>2p<sup>6</sup>3s<sup>2</sup>3p<sup>6</sup> ?

options.content: NaF
NaCl
KBr
CaI<sub>2</sub>

en.explanation:
NaF is composed of Na+ and F–.

Na+ : 1s22s22p6

F- : 1s22s22p6

Hence do not match with the configuration given in the question.
